name: Roads and weather
description: Weather, roadside encounters, travellers, beasts and finds by the wayside.

rows.text: Clear and bright, a good day for walking
High thin cloud, cool and pleasant
Overcast and still
Blustery wind from the west, hats go flying
Light drizzle on and off
Morning fog that burns off by noon
Steady rain, roads turning to mud
Muggy heat and biting flies
Thick fog all day; sight is a stone's throw
Cold snap, frost on the grass at dawn
Thunderstorm in the afternoon, lightning on the hills
Hail for an hour, then sun as if nothing happened
Gale; trees down across the road
Strange weather: [[Strange Sky]]

tables.name: Strange Sky
rows: a red haze and a copper-coloured sun
warm rain that smells of flowers
snow in high summer, melting as it lands
two rainbows crossed over the road
a silent storm, lightning with no thunder
clouds that move against the wind
a night so dark no stars show at all
a falling star that lands somewhere near
mist that forms shapes if you watch too long
birds all flying south at once, in silence
a moon that rises twice
the air tastes of iron and every dog howls

rows.text: Nothing but the road and the birds
A traveller on the road: [[Traveller]]
Two travellers walking together: [[Traveller]], and [[Traveller]]
Tracks and signs of [[Wild Beast]] crossing the road
[[Wild Beast]], close by and not yet aware of you
Something by the wayside: [[Roadside Find]]
A toll post; [[1d6]] guards want [[2d6]] coppers each
A broken-down cart and a driver begging for help
A roadside shrine with fresh offerings on it
[[1d6]] bandits wait where the road narrows
A patrol of riders who ask your business
A burnt farmhouse, still smoking
A crossroads sign that has been turned the wrong way
A funeral procession that asks you to walk with them a while
The weather turns: [[Weather]]
Something that should not be here, and it has seen you

tables.name: Traveller
rows: a pedlar with a mule loaded with pots
a pilgrim going barefoot to a distant shrine
a messenger riding hard who will not stop
a family moving house with everything on one cart
a tinker who mends anything for a meal
a wandering minstrel with a cracked lute
a deserter still in half a uniform
a herder driving [[2d6]] goats
a scholar lost and too proud to admit it
a noble's servant searching for a runaway horse
an old woman gathering herbs who knows the land
a bounty hunter with a sketch of a face
a pair of young lovers who clearly ran away
a beggar with a very fine pair of boots
a travelling healer with a satchel of remedies
a courier guarding a small locked box
a hunter carrying a fresh kill
a monk under a vow of silence
a merchant whose guards quit this morning
a child alone, looking for someone

tables.name: Wild Beast

rows.text: a herd of deer
a wild boar

rows: a lone grey wolf
a pack of [[1d4]] wolves
a brown bear and her cubs
a bad-tempered badger
a swarm of wild bees
an escaped bull
a giant spider in a roadside thicket
a flock of crows that follows you
a mountain cat watching from a rock
a stray war dog with a torn collar
a huge old stag with a crown of antlers
a snake sunning itself across the path

tables.name: Roadside Find
rows: a dropped purse with [[2d6]] silver in it
a lame horse still saddled
a milestone with fresh scratches: a warning in thieves' marks
a shallow grave, recently dug
an abandoned camp with the fire still warm
a letter sealed with wax, addressed to someone in the next town
a broken sword stuck in the ground like a marker
a cage on a cart, door open, empty
a well with a bucket and very cold water
a basket of apples someone left for travellers
a hanged man's gibbet, creaking
a signpost with one arm painted red
a lost child's toy, a carved wooden horse
a wagon wheel rut that leads off into the woods
a stone circle no taller than your knee
a boot, a single one, very expensive
